name: DSH Tauri
description: Message bridge for the DeepSeek Harness desktop shell. Also carries the desktop authentication adaptation: the embedded sandboxed WebView is cross-origin, so it cannot complete the SameSite=Strict browser-session cookie exchange.

name: DSH Running Changes
description: Turn-level change tracking for the desktop shell: a private Git snapshot per agent turn and an input-dock chip reporting the changed files and +N -M of the turn that is currently running. Restoring files is handled by the recommended dsh-rewind plugin.

name: DSH Tauri UI
description: Customized Tauri UI plugin for the DeepSeek Harness desktop shell: provides the settings sidebar, settings sections, and shared UI integration points

name: DSH Tauri Worktree
description: Per-session isolated Git Worktree for the desktop shell: switch a conversation to its own isolated worktree, then check changes back into a local dsh/ branch or discard them.

name: DSH Tauri Panel Extension
description: Skills, MCP, and the plugin market in the DeepSeek Harness desktop extension panel.

name: DSH Tauri Panel Scheduler
description: Scheduled tasks for the DeepSeek Harness desktop panel: create daily/interval/workday/weekly automations, run them in fresh sessions on schedule, and review run history.

name: DSH Tauri Session
description: Session archive for the desktop: rewrites the workspace browser's 'delete workspace' action into 'archive workspace', and adds an 'Archived chats' settings page with search, sort, grouping, project filter and unarchive.

name: DSH Tauri Pet
description: Persistent animated desktop pets with conversation activity states, bubbles, and Chat/Codex pet libraries.

name: DSH Tauri Rightclick Menu
description: Native-style right-click context menu for the desktop shell: quick actions for sessions, workspaces, conversation text, links, and inputs — in-house successor to the deprecated dsh-session-context-menu.

name: DSH Tauri Model Config
description: Model selection and parameter configuration for the DeepSeek Harness desktop shell
